transport.title: Getting there
transport.text: Terminal 2 is at Airport North station on the northern extension of metro line 3. There is no direct metro to Terminal 3: take line 3 to Airport North, then the shuttle from door 42 of Terminal 2 or the intercity train from the GTC transport centre of Terminal 2. Guangzhou metro hours may change.

taxi.title: Taxi
taxi.text: At Terminal 2 taxis pick up at the GTC transport centre: the east rank is outside door 53, the west rank outside door 50. At Terminal 3 the international taxi rank is on Level 1 in the arrivals area, outside door 75.

lounges.title: Lounges
lounges.text: Premium Lounge — Terminal 2, Level 4, behind the duty-free shop after international controls, round the clock. Easy Boarding Lounge — Terminal 2, opposite the China Southern first-class lounge (after security turn left, 50 m), 04:45–21:30. China Southern Sky Pearl lounges in Terminal 2: domestic — on Level 3 after security (05:45–21:00), international — on Level 4 past the duty-free area (from 04:30 until the last flight). In Terminal 3 — L32 Lounge on Level 4 behind a separate security checkpoint for domestic flights (opposite counter 16 of island K), from 05:00 until the last departure.

storage.title: Left luggage
storage.hint: All terminals, some round the clock
storage.text: Terminal 1: departure hall, Level 3, by door 16 — round the clock. Terminal 2: behind check-in area C of the departure hall (04:30–23:30), behind check-in area P/N (round the clock) and opposite door 53 of the arrival hall (05:30–23:30). Terminal 3: by the toilets behind island C in the west part of the check-in hall (round the clock) and in the international arrival hall on Level 1 (05:30–21:30). Hours may change depending on the situation on site.

sleep.title: Where to sleep
sleep.hint: Capsules in T2, T3, round the clock
sleep.text: Pay-by-the-hour capsules — Terminal 2, Level 1, international arrivals area, by door 53, round the clock. NAPHUBS capsules — Terminal 3, Level 4: in the rest area for overnight passengers to the left behind door 61 and in the international transit hall, also round the clock.

wifi.title: Wi‑Fi
wifi.text: Free AIRPORT-FREE-WiFi network. On the login page you can sign in with your phone number and a code from an SMS (foreigners select their country code) or with a photo of an identity document. There are Wi‑Fi kiosks in the international departure and arrival areas of Terminal 2.
